_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Wɔyɛ ɔkɔtɔni {player_id} wɔ Abien Three-Player Tic Tac Toe.
Wɔde '{symbol}' hyɛ wo. 
Wɔde wo ho hyɛ bɔɔde a ɛwɔ 5x5 so forma mpoano a ɛyɛ nan.
Mpoano no bɛtɔ gu, anaasɛ ɛbɛkɔ faako, anaasɛ ɛbɛkɔ kɔkɔɔ.
De wo mmɔbɔ so sɛ '[4]' de hyɛ fie a ɛto so 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ntotoho a enni mu. Fa '[cell]' di dwuma bere a ɔdan no yɛ 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nsɛm a ɛyɛ hu: {cell}. Ɛbɛyɛ sɛ ɛfiri 0 kɔsi {max_cell}.

game_action.placed: ɔkɔtɔni {player_id} de ne ho hyɛ ({symbol}) wɔ fie ({row}, {col}).
